exec: pm.test("Server price and snapshot",()=>{const x=pm.response.json();pm.expect(x.details.length).to.eql(2);pm.expect(x.totalPrice).to.eql(190000);pm.expect(x.totalPrice).to.eql(x.details.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.price,0));pm.expect(x.details[0].movieTitle).to.eql("Hành Trình Phương Nam");});
